top_signals.title: Sri Lankan Inflation to Slow Toward Goal, Central Bank Head Says
top_signals.summary: Sri Lanka’s inflation is expected to slow back toward the central bank’s target of 5% over the second half of this year and into next year, according to Governor Nandalal Weerasinghe.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Copper Heads Toward Record High on LME as Supply Tensions Build
top_signals.summary: Copper extended a seven-week rally to head toward a record, with a key price spread on the London Metal Exchange widening to unusual levels in a clear sign of rising competition for short-term supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Silver Traders Brave Red Tape to Capture Indian Premiums
top_signals.summary: Shipments of silver into India are picking up despite administrative hurdles, as traders seek to capitalize on attractive premiums after a new licensing regime disrupted imports.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Top U.S. commander acknowledges mental health issues on USS Lincoln
top_signals.summary: Cooper's visit and statement come after reports of widespread morale and mental health concerns aboard the Lincoln.

top_signals.title: What the results of a Connecticut congressional primary race may mean for Social Security
top_signals.summary: Rep. John Larson of Connecticut, an advocate for expanding Social Security, was ousted in a Democratic primary contest Tuesday.
